anchor.semantic_hook: Good faith is made visible as a pristine heart-shaped reliquary held between two open sculpted hands above every honest exchange.
anchor.setting: An empty transaction hall contains a plain counter, balanced scales, exchange trays, and two facing chairs. Above the counter, a building-sized crystal heart-shaped reliquary hovers unsupported between two open stone hands. The surrounding furnishings have normal proportions.
anchor.absurd_element: a building-sized crystal heart reliquary hovering between open stone hands
